text:
Zara: Quick heads-up: launching an "access-tidy" sprint today. Objective: reclaim stale admin grants and collect SOC2-grade evidence. 10-day window.
Owen: SGTM. Scope?
Zara: prod + staging admin roles, cross-account roles, ownerless service accounts. Rule of thumb: console/API last-use > 120d OR no owner metadata.
Diego: KMS nuance: a role can be a Grantee on a KMS grant. we cannot drop the role if the grant is active. what's the safe sequence?
Amelia: Proposed sequence: export grants -> freeze/redirect grants -> remove IAM bindings. Commands I'll use: `aws kms list-grants --key-id KID --query "Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ROLE']"` -> save to s3.
Amelia: Example snapshot commands: `aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --output json > /tmp/$K-grants.json`
Amelia: then `aws s3 cp /tmp/$K-grants.json s3://sec-audit/access-tidy/$K-$(date +%F).json --acl bucket-owner-full-control`
SecBot: Created SEC-301:access-tidy-evidence and attached CloudTrail slice + initial IAM diff.
Owen: Can we automate the notify+tag step? i.e. tag roles `access-tidy:pending` and fire a single job to message owners with evidence links.
Legal: looped in. Auto-revoke policy for non-human service accounts is acceptable if notice + 72h window + evidence retention present. Human accounts require justification.
Diego: We also need cross-system binding checks (Vault, k8s RBAC, GCP). I've got a tool: `./tools/find_cross_bindings --role ROLE` — will add that to the pipeline.
Zara: Draft remediation playbook (short):
```
1) ./tools/ownerless_finder --days 120 > ownerless.txt
2) for r in $(cat ownerless.txt); do
     aws iam tag-role --role-name $r --tags Key=access-tidy,Value=pending
     export grants: aws kms list-grants --key-id $K --query 'Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/$r']' > /tmp/$r-grants.json
     ./tools/find_cross_bindings --role $r > /tmp/$r-bindings.txt
     notify owner via template (attach s3 links, cloudtrail slice)
   done
3) wait 72h for justification/logs
4) if svcacct && no justification -> create remediation ticket + revoke inline policies + detach non-essential managed policies
5) if human && no justification -> escalate to manager + keep role frozen (tag access-tidy:hold)
6) upload all artifacts (email headers, cloudtrail, iam-change payloads) to SEC-301
```
Owen: Escalation for contested removals?
Zara: contested -> ping #eng-security oncall + EngInfra lead. 8h hold for approvals, after which SecLead+Infra must sign off to proceed.
KeyOps: For keys with tag `prod_scope=true` we require KeyOps approval before changing grants. Do NOT auto-revoke those grants.
Amelia: Tech note: when revoking a grant, prefer to `RevokeGrant` vs deleting keys. record the `RevokeGrant` payload in the ticket.
SecBot: SEC-301 updated: grants_snapshot.csv and notifications.log uploaded.
Diego: I'll kick off the finder against infra clusters and GCP projects this afternoon.
Owen: i'll wire the notify job (temp zap) and include the evidence placeholders (cloudtrail link, s3 artifact).
Legal: please ensure email headers + DSAR-safe redaction flow if any customer PII appears in logs.
KeyOps: will triage keys flagged prod_scope and respond within 48h.
Zara: thanks team. I'll post the notify template and a short how-to for evidence upload. Check for false positives and flag them in-thread. :white_check_mark:
Owen: ack.
Amelia: starting grants export now.
Diego: starting cross-binding checks.
SecBot: Thread closed for now — any followups create SEC-301 subtask.
